title: Browngurus mob pack
description: A resource pack that replaces skeleton and zombie mobs with custom mobs i made up
body:
This is a resource pack I made that replaces zombie and skeleton mobs and their variants with custom creatures i designed 

changes include:
zombie: slime beast
husk: sand man
Drowned: sea beast
Skeleton: skeletron
bogged: rusty skeletron
stray: icy skeletron
